description: This file defines a PHP class 'SubscriptionStatus' within the namespace 'Opencart.Admin.Controller.Localisation'. The class manages CRUD operations for subscription status entries in the OpenCart admin interface, including listing, adding, editing, saving, and deleting subscription statuses. It interacts with models, views, and routing components to facilitate these operations.

classes.name: SubscriptionStatus
classes.description: Controller class for managing subscription status data in the admin area, supporting listing, creating, editing, saving, and deleting subscription statuses.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main method to display the list of subscription statuses with sorting, pagination, and navigation.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Returns the list view of subscription statuses, primarily used for AJAX calls.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Retrieves and processes the list of subscription statuses with sorting, filtering, pagination, and prepares the data for rendering.

methods.name: form
methods.description: Displays the form for adding or editing a subscription status.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles saving new or updated subscription status data, returns JSON response indicating success or error.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes selected subscription statuses and responds with JSON data.
